title: AI Memory Actor Output
description: Output of the AI Memory Actor. Each run produces one dataset item containing the action result (remember, recall, search, forget, context_pack, update, stats, prune, chunk) and a full OUTPUT record in the key-value store.

results.title: Action Results
results.description: Dataset item containing the action result. Fields include: action, ok, message, memoryStoreId, storeName, memory (for remember/update), memories[] (for recall/search), totalMemories/byType (for stats), chunks[] (for chunk), and scores[] for ranked search results.

output.title: Full OUTPUT Record
output.description: Complete action result stored as the OUTPUT key in the default key-value store. Same structure as the dataset item — useful for direct programmatic access.
